question: Who among the following players won the men’s player of the year award in the Hockey India Awards 2023 that was held in New Delhi on 31 March 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hardik Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Hardik Singh was named the men's player of the year at the Hockey India Awards 2023 held in New Delhi on 31 March 2024.
 
• He plays as a midfielder for the Indian national hockey team.
 
• Hardik Singh has been recognized for his exceptional performance and consistent contribution to the team.
 
• He has previously represented India in various international tournaments, including the FIH Men's Hockey World Cup.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hockey India Awards**

 
 
• The Hockey India Awards are organized annually to honor the best players, coaches, and officials in Indian hockey.
 
• These awards aim to recognize and celebrate the achievements and contributions of individuals to the sport of hockey in India.
 
 
 
• **Men's Player of the Year Award**
 
 
• This award is given to the most outstanding male hockey player of the year based on their performance and impact on the field.
 
 
 
• **FIH Men's Hockey World Cup**
 
 
• The FIH Men's Hockey World Cup is an international field hockey competition organized by the International Hockey Federation (FIH).
 
• It is one of the most prestigious tournaments in the sport, held every four years.
 
 
 
• **Midfielder Role in Hockey**
 
 
• The midfielder plays a crucial role in both defense and attack, linking the backline with the forward players.
 
• A good midfielder needs to have excellent ball control, vision, and the ability to make quick decisions under pressure.
